bible_quanes.question: How was the land to be divided?
Did the sons of Korah die in his rebellion?
Which tribes received larger inheritances?
bible_quanes.answer: To many the more inheritance, to few the less

bible_quanes.question: How many Levites were counted in the second census?
bible_quanes.explanation: Males a month old and above.

bible_quanes.question: Whose daughters are mentioned because he had no sons?
bible_quanes.explanation: They would later ask for an inheritance.

bible_quanes.question: What was the name of Amram's wife?
bible_quanes.explanation: The mother of Aaron, Moses and Miriam.

bible_quanes.question: Why were only Caleb and Joshua left from the first census?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness

bible_quanes.question: Who asked Moses for an inheritance?
What did the Lord say about their request?
bible_quanes.answer: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right; give them a possession of an inheritance

bible_quanes.question: Whom did God choose to succeed Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: A man in whom is the Spirit.

bible_quanes.question: From which mountain range did God tell Moses to view the land?
Name one of the daughters of Zelophehad.
bible_quanes.answer: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah or Tirzah

bible_quanes.question: What was the rule if a man died with no son?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses not want the people to be?
bible_quanes.answer: As sheep which have no shepherd

bible_quanes.question: Who would inquire of God for Joshua by the Urim?
bible_quanes.explanation: Joshua would go out at his word.

bible_quanes.question: How did Moses commission Joshua?
bible_quanes.answer: He laid his hands on him

bible_quanes.question: Why was Moses reminded he could not enter the land?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, at the water of Meribah

bible_quanes.question: What was offered every day as a continual burnt offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Two lambs of the first year without spot
bible_quanes.explanation: One in the morning, one at twilight.

bible_quanes.question: What extra offering was made on the Sabbath?
bible_quanes.answer: Two lambs of the first year without spot

bible_quanes.question: When was the LORD's Passover?
bible_quanes.answer: The fourteenth day of the first month

bible_quanes.question: What feast is called the day of firstfruits?
What was offered at the beginning of each month?
bible_quanes.answer: Two young bullocks, one ram and seven lambs

bible_quanes.question: What was the drink offering with each lamb?
bible_quanes.answer: A fourth of a hin of strong drink

bible_quanes.question: On which day did the Feast of Unleavened Bread begin?
bible_quanes.answer: The fifteenth day of the first month

bible_quanes.question: What sin offering was made at the new moon?
What meat offering went with each daily lamb?
bible_quanes.answer: A tenth part of an ephah of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil

bible_quanes.question: Where was the continual burnt offering first ordained?
What was the first day of the seventh month?
bible_quanes.answer: A day of blowing the trumpets

bible_quanes.question: What was the tenth day of the seventh month?
bible_quanes.answer: A day to afflict their souls

bible_quanes.question: What began on the fifteenth day of the seventh month?
bible_quanes.answer: A feast unto the LORD seven days

bible_quanes.question: What was held on the eighth day of that feast?
How many bulls were offered on the first day of Tabernacles?
How many bulls were offered on the seventh day of Tabernacles?
How many bulls were offered on the eighth day?
bible_quanes.explanation: Along with one ram and seven lambs.

bible_quanes.question: What did Israel offer besides the appointed feast offerings?
How many male lambs were offered each day of Tabernacles?
Did Moses pass on these instructions?
bible_quanes.answer: Yes, according to all that the LORD commanded
bible_quanes.explanation: He told the children of Israel.

bible_quanes.question: What must a man do when he makes a vow?
bible_quanes.answer: Not break his word, but do all that proceedeth out of his mouth

bible_quanes.question: What happened if a father overruled his daughter's vow?
bible_quanes.answer: Not any of her vows shall stand, and the LORD shall forgive her

bible_quanes.question: What happened if a husband overruled his wife's vow?
bible_quanes.answer: He shall make her vow of none effect

bible_quanes.question: What about the vow of a widow or divorced woman?
What if a father heard his daughter's vow and said nothing?
What if a husband voided his wife's vow some time after hearing it?
To whom did Moses speak about vows?
What happened when a husband voided a vow on the day he heard it?
How does Numbers 30 describe these laws?
bible_quanes.answer: Statutes between a man and his wife, and a father and his daughter

bible_quanes.question: Which vows could a husband confirm or void?
bible_quanes.answer: Every vow and binding oath to afflict her soul

bible_quanes.question: Against whom did God command vengeance?
How many soldiers did each tribe send?
Which priest went with the army?
bible_quanes.explanation: With the holy articles and trumpets.

bible_quanes.question: Which prophet was killed with the Midianites?
Why were the Midianite women held responsible?
bible_quanes.answer: These caused Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass in the matter of Peor

bible_quanes.question: How long did the soldiers stay outside the camp?
How were metal items purified?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye shall make it go through the fire
bible_quanes.explanation: And with the water of purification.

bible_quanes.question: How was the plunder divided?
bible_quanes.answer: Into two parts: to them that went out to battle and to all the congregation

bible_quanes.question: How many Israelite soldiers were missing after the battle?
What did the officers offer to the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: Jewels of gold: chains, bracelets, rings, earrings and tablets

bible_quanes.question: Which tribes had a very great multitude of cattle?
bible_quanes.explanation: They wanted the land of Gilead.

bible_quanes.question: Complete: "Be sure your sin will ..."
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses' warning to Reuben and Gad.

bible_quanes.question: Which half-tribe also settled east of the Jordan?
What did Reuben and Gad promise to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Go ready armed before the children of Israel

bible_quanes.question: Why was Moses angry at their request?
bible_quanes.answer: Wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over?

bible_quanes.question: What did Reuben and Gad want to build?
bible_quanes.answer: Sheepfolds for their cattle and cities for their little ones

bible_quanes.question: Who does Moses say wholly followed the LORD?
To whom did Moses give command about the agreement?
bible_quanes.answer: Eleazar the priest, Joshua and the chief fathers of the tribes

bible_quanes.question: What did Jair call the towns he captured?
Which family of Manasseh took Gilead?
What did Moses write down in Numbers 33?
bible_quanes.answer: Their goings out according to their journeys
bible_quanes.explanation: By the command of the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: From which place did Israel depart Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: On the fifteenth day of the first month.

bible_quanes.question: How old was Aaron when he died?
What were they to do with the inhabitants of Canaan?
What were the Egyptians doing as Israel left?
bible_quanes.answer: The Egyptians buried all their firstborn
bible_quanes.explanation: God executed judgment on their gods.

bible_quanes.question: What did Israel find at Elim?
bible_quanes.answer: Twelve fountains of water and threescore and ten palm trees

bible_quanes.question: What would the inhabitants they failed to drive out become?
bible_quanes.answer: Pricks in their eyes and thorns in their sides

bible_quanes.question: When did Aaron die?
bible_quanes.answer: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the fifth month

bible_quanes.question: How was the land to be divided among families?
Where was Israel's final camp before entering Canaan?
bible_quanes.answer: The plains of Moab by the Jordan
bible_quanes.explanation: From Beth Jesimoth to Abel Acacia Grove.

bible_quanes.question: Which land was Israel to inherit?
What was the western border of the land?
Who divided the land among the tribes?
How many tribes received land west of the Jordan?
bible_quanes.explanation: The others had land east of the Jordan.

bible_quanes.question: From where did the southern border begin?
bible_quanes.answer: The Wilderness of Zin, along Edom

bible_quanes.question: Which sea marked the southern end of the eastern border?
How many helpers did God appoint to divide the land?
Who was the leader for the tribe of Judah?
Which sea is named on the eastern border?
Which tribes inherited land east of the Jordan?
bible_quanes.answer: Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh

bible_quanes.question: What did the Levites receive to live in?
How many cities of refuge were there?
bible_quanes.explanation: For anyone who killed someone unintentionally.

bible_quanes.question: How many cities did the Levites receive in total?
bible_quanes.explanation: Including the six cities of refuge.

bible_quanes.question: What were the cities of refuge for?
bible_quanes.answer: That the slayer which killeth any person at unawares may flee thither

bible_quanes.question: How many cities of refuge were east of the Jordan?
How long did the manslayer have to stay in the city of refuge?
bible_quanes.answer: Unto the death of the high priest

bible_quanes.question: How many witnesses were needed to put a murderer to death?
bible_quanes.answer: One witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die

bible_quanes.question: Could a ransom be accepted for a murderer?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was to be put to death.

bible_quanes.question: How far did the Levites' pasturelands extend from the city wall?
What pollutes the land according to Numbers 35:33?
bible_quanes.explanation: It is atoned for only by the blood of the one who shed it.

bible_quanes.question: Who raised a concern about the daughters of Zelophehad?
bible_quanes.answer: The chief fathers of the families of Gilead

bible_quanes.question: Whom were the daughters of Zelophehad to marry?
bible_quanes.answer: To whom they think best, only to the family of the tribe of their father
bible_quanes.explanation: To keep the land in the tribe.

bible_quanes.question: What was not to happen to inheritances?
bible_quanes.answer: The inheritance shall not remove from tribe to tribe

bible_quanes.question: Where were the final commands of Numbers given?
bible_quanes.answer: In the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho

bible_quanes.question: What was the concern about the Year of Jubilee?
bible_quanes.answer: Their inheritance shall be put unto the tribe whereunto they are received
bible_quanes.explanation: It would be lost to Manasseh.

bible_quanes.question: Did the daughters of Zelophehad obey?
bible_quanes.answer: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad
bible_quanes.explanation: They did as the LORD commanded Moses.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did the daughters marry?
In which tribe did their inheritance remain?
List the five daughters of Zelophehad as named in Numbers 36.
bible_quanes.answer: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah and Noah

bible_quanes.question: What rule applied to every daughter who inherited land?
bible_quanes.answer: She shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father
bible_quanes.explanation: So each tribe kept its inheritance.
